final: {"prompt":"A square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image edge to edge, with no border or frame. Build a charged field of deep ultramarine, bruised violet, and near-black, interrupted by sharp currents of vermilion, hot coral, and pale electric yellow. Use dense, scraped layers and restless dry-brush marks that gather into compressed knots, then break apart into broad, quiet expanses of translucent blue-gray. Let vigorous diagonal gestures cross and interrupt one another, with fine granular textures caught beneath glossy sweeps and occasional raw patches where the underlayers show through. Balance agitation and restraint: a dense, luminous concentration slightly off center, with generous but uneasy empty space pressing in from one side. Keep every mark purely abstract and nonreferential; include no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No setting, wall, room, or gallery—only the square painting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
